text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the history of the Twinkle Series,
"Who is the strongest Mile Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a topic that often comes up
among the fans, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Setting 'strongest' aside, Oguri Cap's way of winning is often called the most dramatic!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
I was simply running with all my might. But...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It might look that way because she never wins easily and it's always a close race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san's running has earned quite a high reputation too! She's achieved consecutive victories in the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. But rather than being called the strongest miler,
I'd rather—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The coolest Umamusume around!
That's what I wanna be called!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And Taiki Shuttle!
Winning an overseas Mile Gâ  is truly monumental
in so many ways!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Of course I love mile races, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who tells me they love my races
gets a big hug from me♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't know who's the strongest,
but in terms of total wins, the top isâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's Gran Alegria, desu!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth!
She's won the most races, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've won so many times, I've lost count.
Just like the number of extra servings I've had.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Gran Alegria-san, everyone among the Umamusume is saying it's countless, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: As a reporter, I remember everything, of course.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS, the Oka Sho,
the NHK Mile Cup,
back-to-back Yasuda Kinen victories, and back-to-back Mile CS victories.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, a total of 8 wins in the
Victoria Mile! You couldn't possibly have
won any more than that!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: You're right! The mile is the one thing I definitely won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like those feelings
were what led to this result!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Then let me ask you point-blank.
In the entire history of the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Who do you think is the strongest mile Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The strongest miler...
That would be—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"That's me!
Gran Alegria is the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ooh... You said that without a shred of hesitation! Is that confidence born from all your victories?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true.
Because I'm—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It wasn't me, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Huh, isn't it me?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! My mile running is...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I've incorporated techniques from the seniors
renowned as the strongest as well!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Taiki-senpai's Jacques le Marois!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've watched that video over and over again!
The moment you crossed the goal was so cool!
I even watched it in slow motion!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship with Oguri-senpai
and Bamboo-senpai was a legendary match too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Just when you think it's all over,
Oguri-senpai surges from the inside!
It gives me chills down my spine!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even against Bakushin O-senpai, the strongest sprinter,
North Flight-senpai never gave an inch in the miles.
I look up to her so much!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I thought, 'I love that outfit too!'
and bought something similar to wear,
but I couldn't pull it off at all~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've watched all the famous mile races, and I still do.
On DVD, on UmaTube, and of course, the 4K remastered versions too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Every single one of those runs
has become a part of who I am!
That is why—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I am not just myself!
Because I've respected and learned from all the strongest milers more than anyone—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I won every single turf mile GⅠ! And because of that, I know I'm stronger than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
S-Spectacular...!!
Gran Alegria-san herself is truly the very culmination of the mile.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Now I understand how you won eight Mile G1 races! Please keep on winning from now on too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Words alone couldn't capture it, but running alongside Zephyr-senpai, Helios-senpai, and everyone else—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep charging down
the center of the Mile Road—now and forever!!!"
